headline: Smith-Midland Wins $2.2 Million Virginia School Contract for SlenderWall
summary: Smith-Midland Corporation secured a $2.2 million contract to supply its SlenderWall precast concrete products for a school building project in Virginia.
why: Precast concrete manufacturers rely on public infrastructure and commercial building contracts to drive revenue growth and capacity utilization.

impacts.name: Smith-Midland Corporation
impacts.why: New project awards provide direct backlog growth and validate commercial demand for proprietary precast building systems.
